name: The Baroda Rayon Corp Ltd.
summary: The Baroda Rayon Corp Ltd. specializes in the production of synthetic fibers such as nylon and rayon. Its product portfolio includes viscose filament yarn, various types of yarns like nylon and polyester yarn, and nylon tyre cord, in addition to industrial chemicals like carbon disulphide (CS2) and sulphuric acid. This company was established in 1958 and maintains its primary operational base in Mumbai, India.
